T00_1.en: Can you hear me? ...Right, comms are good.

T00_2.zh: 欢迎来到 BERTH 07。今天第一天上班，先别碰停在外面的那些大船。
T00_2.en: Welcome to Berth 07. First day on the job — leave the big hulls outside alone for now.

T00_3.zh: 中间这个是 TS-1，报废穿梭机上切下来的训练舱段，正好拿来练手。
T00_3.en: That one in the middle is TS-1, a training section cut off a scrapped shuttle. Good for practice.

T00_4.zh: 远程操作权限已确认。训练项目 TS-1 已载入。
T00_4.en: REMOTE OPERATION AUTHORISED. TRAINING ITEM TS-1 LOADED.

T00_5.zh: 今天只有一条规矩：不确定的东西，先查清楚再动。
T00_5.en: One rule today: if you're not sure, check before you touch it.

T01_in.zh: 先把无人机飞起来。穿过那几个光环。
T01_in.en: Get the drone moving first. Fly through those rings.

T01_dash.zh: 长的那个，按住 Shift 冲过去。
T01_dash.en: The long one — hold Shift and dash through.

T01_stop.en: Into the box, Space to stop dead.

T01_f.zh: F 是飞行稳定。关掉试试，再开回来。
T01_f.en: F is flight assist. Switch it off, feel it, switch it back on.

T01_find.zh: 看到左侧那块检修盖了吗？找找它的编号。
T01_find.en: See the service cover on the left side? Find its number.

T01_bp1.zh: 图纸是设计的时候画的，船是后来撞坏的。两边不一定对得上。
T01_bp1.en: The drawing was made at design time. The ship got wrecked later. They won't always agree.

T01_bp2.zh: 先用它找东西，至于东西现在是什么样，你自己检查。
T01_bp2.en: Use it to find things. What state they're in now — you check that yourself.

T01_h1.zh: 面板就在舱段左侧。先把摄像头拉近。
T01_h1.en: The panel is on the left end of the section. Zoom in first.

T02_in1.zh: 这块盖板已经检查过了，没有压力，也没接电。
T02_in1.en: That cover's been checked. No pressure behind it, no power.

T02_in2.zh: 任务很简单，把它完整拆下来，送进回收口。别直接拿切割器烧。四颗螺栓。
T02_in2.en: Simple job: take it off in one piece and into a mouth. Don't burn it off. Four bolts.

T02_last.zh: 先等等。最后一个螺栓拆掉，这块板就没东西固定了。用抓钩把它稳住。
T02_last.en: Hold on. Take the last bolt out and nothing holds that plate. Steady it with the grapple first.

T02_drift.zh: 看见没有？这地方没有地板替你接东西。下次先固定，再松最后一个连接。
T02_drift.en: See that? There's no floor out here to catch things. Secure it first, then the last fixing.

T02_done_t.zh: 金属结构回收完成。回收重量 0.18 t。资产价值 120 信用点。

T02_done_l.zh: 第一笔收入，够买几杯咖啡。先别急着发财，接下来还有正事。
T02_done_l.en: First earnings — a few coffees' worth. Don't get rich yet, the real work's next.

T02_h1.zh: 四个角上那几颗螺栓，用维护工具一颗一颗拧。
T02_h1.en: The bolts down its edge — wrench them out one by one.

T03_in.zh: 这块外壳后面是密封舱。想拆可以，先确认里面还有没有气。
T03_in.en: Behind that shell plate is a sealed bay. Fine to take it off — once you know there's no gas in there.

T03_ask.zh: 读数出来了。你觉得现在能拆吗？
T03_ask.en: There's your reading. Safe to take it off now?

T03_A.zh: 零倒是零。可它测的是哪儿？先把工程图打开。
T03_A.en: It's zero, sure. But zero where? Open the drawing.

T03_B.zh: 对，先确定你测的是哪一段。
T03_B.en: Right. First work out which bit you actually measured.

T03_found.zh: 阀门关着，压力表根本没连到舱室。仪器没坏。是你刚才不知道它测的是什么。
T03_found.en: The valve's shut — the gauge never saw the bay. The meter's fine. You just didn't know what it was measuring.

T03_real.zh: 这回才是舱里的压力。要是刚才直接拆开，里面的气就全跑到船坞里了。
T03_real.en: That's the bay. Open it a minute ago and all that gas goes into the berth.

T03_wait.zh: 这回不用着急，等泵把气收完。真空里工作，最没用的就是催机器。
T03_wait.en: No hurry now. Let the pump take it. Out here, rushing machines gets you nothing.

T03_empty_t.zh: 舱室压力进入训练允许范围。气体回收完成。
T03_empty_t.en: BAY PRESSURE WITHIN TRAINING LIMIT. GAS RECOVERED.

T03_empty_l.zh: 好。现在可以处理这块外壳了。

T03_open.zh: 这就是拆船。你不知道里面是什么，就得一点点把它查清楚。
T03_open.en: That's salvage. You don't know what's inside, so you find out, one thing at a time.

T03_lock_t.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：目标舱室状态未确认。
T03_lock_t.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: TARGET BAY NOT VERIFIED.

T03_lock_l.zh: 真船可不会替你拦这一下。
T03_lock_l.en: A real ship won't stop you like that.

T03_boom.en: ...Good thing nobody was in there. Resetting. Again.

T03_h1.zh: 看看测压口和舱室之间，管子上还有什么。
T03_h1.en: Look at what sits on the line between the port and the bay.

T04_in1.zh: 现在要回收这个供电模块。

T04_in2.zh: 控制台说主电源关了。不过旁边那盏灯还亮着。你先查查。
T04_in2.en: The panel says main power's off. That lamp next to it says otherwise. Check.

T04_backup_l.zh: 明白了吧？主电源停了，备用电池还在供电。船上的电源从来不保证只有一个。
T04_backup_l.en: See? Main's off, the backup battery is still feeding it. A ship never promises just one source.

T04_cap.zh: 还有电容。先让设备完成受控放电和状态验证。别急着拆。
T04_cap.en: And there's the capacitor. Bleed it through the plug and verify. Don't rush it.

T04_ok_t.zh: 目标电气区域验证完成。允许进行指定模块拆卸。
T04_ok_t.en: ELECTRICAL ZONE VERIFIED. MODULE REMOVAL PERMITTED.

T04_done.zh: 这就对了。要是把完整模块直接烧成废铁，老板估计比电容炸了还心疼。
T04_done.en: That's it. Burn a whole module down to scrap and the boss would cry harder than if the cap blew.

T04_lock_t.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：目标电气区域未验证。
T04_lock_t.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: ELECTRICAL ZONE NOT VERIFIED.

T04_arc.zh: 那一下，在真船上能要命。重置。
T04_arc.en: On a real ship that one kills. Resetting.

T04_h1.zh: 灯还亮着，电是从哪儿来的？图纸的电路层里找找。
T04_h1.en: The lamp's still lit — where's that power coming from? Look at the circuit in the drawing.

T05_in1.zh: 那边还有台冷却泵。这东西能卖点钱。你把它完整取下来。
T05_in1.en: There's a coolant pump over there. Worth something. Get it out whole.

T05_in2.zh: 不用我再告诉你先查什么了吧？
T05_in2.en: I don't need to tell you what to check first, do I?

T05_pull.zh: 别拽了。看一眼，下面还有东西连着呢。
T05_pull.en: Stop pulling. Look — something's still attached.

T05_cut.zh: 也行，至少能卖废金属。不过下次可以试着把整台拿下来，价钱差得不少。
T05_cut.en: Fine, it'll sell as scrap. Next time try getting it out whole — big difference in price.

T05_done_l.zh: 不错。这才叫拆设备，不是拆垃圾。
T05_done_l.en: Nice. That's salvaging equipment, not shovelling junk.

T06_in.zh: 最后剩这些骨架。拆完训练就结束。
T06_in.en: Just the frame left. Clear it and training's done.

T06_heavy1.zh: 超重了。你可以去仓库买台更大的设备，前提是老板愿意出钱。
T06_heavy1.en: Too heavy. You could buy a bigger grapple — if the boss pays for it.

T06_heavy2.zh: 今天就用现有的工具。看看能不能把它分开。
T06_heavy2.en: Today you use what you've got. See if it splits.

T06_boom.zh: 残液进炉子，就是这个下场。重置。
T06_boom.en: Residue in the furnace — that's what happens. Resetting.

T06_done_t.zh: TS-1 拆解任务完成。训练舱段剩余可回收结构：0。

T06_done_l.zh: 行，至少你没把船坞一起拆了。培训先到这儿。
T06_done_l.en: Well, you didn't take the berth apart with it. That's training.

T06_h3.zh: 看看图纸，那根梁是两段拼起来的。
T06_h3.en: Check the drawing — that beam is two pieces joined together.

T_exam_offer.zh: 接下来有个小考核。想试就试，不想试也能直接接第一份合同。
T_exam_offer.en: There's a short test next. Take it if you like — or go straight to your first contract.

TL_lock_t.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：容器内仍有液体。
TL_lock_t.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: THE VESSEL STILL HOLDS LIQUID.

text.zh: 等待接通
text.en: COMMS CHECK

title.en: GET TO KNOW THE BASIC CONTROLS

text.zh: 驾驶无人机依次穿过前方的 3 个光环。
text.en: FLY THE DRONE THROUGH THE 3 RINGS AHEAD, ONE AFTER ANOTHER.

text.zh: 按住 Shift 加速飞行，穿过前方的跑道。
text.en: HOLD SHIFT TO BOOST AND FLY THROUGH THE LONG RING AHEAD.

text.zh: 驾驶无人机进入指定区域，然后按 Space 刹车，让无人机停稳。
text.en: FLY THE DRONE INTO THE MARKED AREA, THEN PRESS SPACE TO BRAKE AND BRING IT TO A STOP.

text.zh: 按住鼠标右键并拖动鼠标，转动视角查看周围的环境。
text.en: HOLD THE RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON AND DRAG TO TURN THE VIEW AND LOOK AROUND YOU.

text.zh: 按住 Z 拉远视角，查看整个舱段的结构。
text.en: HOLD Z TO PULL THE VIEW BACK AND SEE THE STRUCTURE OF THE WHOLE SECTION.

text.zh: 按住 V 开启悬停锁定，让无人机保持在当前位置。
text.en: HOLD V TO TURN ON HOVER LOCK AND KEEP THE DRONE IN ITS CURRENT POSITION.

text.zh: 按 F 关闭飞行稳定功能，再按一次 F 重新开启。
text.en: PRESS F TO TURN FLIGHT ASSIST OFF, THEN PRESS F AGAIN TO TURN IT BACK ON.

text.zh: 无人机已经配备训练探针，切换到测量工具（1），然后点击检修盖 P-001 进行测量。
text.en: THE DRONE IS FITTED WITH A TRAINING PROBE. SWITCH TO MEASURE (1), THEN CLICK ACCESS COVER P-001 TO TAKE A READING.

text.zh: 按 Tab 打开工程图，查看当前舱段的结构。
text.en: PRESS TAB TO OPEN THE DRAWING AND SEE THE STRUCTURE OF THE CURRENT SECTION.

text.zh: 将准星对准螺栓，点击鼠标左键将螺栓拆下来。系统会自动切换到维护工具，你也可以按 4 手动切换。
text.en: AIM THE CROSSHAIR AT A BOLT AND LEFT-CLICK TO REMOVE IT. THE SYSTEM SWITCHES TO THE MAINTENANCE TOOL AUTOMATICALLY, OR YOU CAN PRESS 4 TO SWITCH MANUALLY.

text.zh: 先切换到磁力抓钩（3），固定住盖板，防止盖板在拆除后随意飘动。
text.en: FIRST SWITCH TO GRAPPLE (3) AND HOLD THE COVER STEADY SO IT DOESN’T DRIFT AROUND ONCE IT COMES OFF.

text.zh: 拆下最后一颗螺栓。
text.en: REMOVE THE LAST BOLT.

text.zh: 使用磁力抓钩拖动拆下来的盖板，将它送进金属熔炉进行回收。
text.en: USE THE GRAPPLE TO DRAG THE COVER YOU REMOVED AND DELIVER IT INTO THE METAL FURNACE FOR RECOVERY.

text.zh: 拆下练习废料 SC-T1，然后使用磁力抓钩将废料对准熔炉的长形入口，甩进去就能完成回收，即使距离入口还有 6 米也可以。
text.en: REMOVE PRACTICE SCRAP SC-T1, THEN USE THE GRAPPLE TO LINE IT UP WITH THE FURNACE’S LONG INLET AND FLING IT IN TO RECOVER IT. EVEN 6 m FROM THE INLET IS ENOUGH.

text.zh: 拆下传感器 EQ-T1，尽量保持设备完整，再使用磁力抓钩将它送进设备回收口。
text.en: REMOVE SENSOR EQ-T1, KEEP THE DEVICE AS INTACT AS YOU CAN, THEN USE THE GRAPPLE TO DELIVER IT TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH.

text.zh: 将化学品瓶 HZ-T1 拆下来，送进专门处理危险物品的回收口，注意不要把化学品瓶扔进金属熔炉。
text.en: REMOVE CHEMICAL BOTTLE HZ-T1 AND DELIVER IT TO THE MOUTH THAT HANDLES HAZARDOUS GOODS. DO NOT THROW THE CHEMICAL BOTTLE INTO THE METAL FURNACE.

title.zh: 仪器显示零，不代表已经安全
title.en: A ZERO READING DOESN’T MEAN IT’S SAFE

text.zh: 切换到测量工具（1），检查 PT-02 的压力读数。
text.en: SWITCH TO MEASURE (1) AND CHECK THE PRESSURE READING AT PT-02.

text.zh: 现在仪器显示压力为零，可以直接开始拆解吗？
text.en: THE GAUGE NOW READS ZERO PRESSURE. IS IT OK TO START TAKING IT APART?

a.zh: 可以，仪器显示压力为零，应该已经安全了。
a.en: YES, THE GAUGE READS ZERO PRESSURE, SO IT SHOULD BE SAFE ALREADY.

b.zh: 暂时还不能确定，需要检查测量管路有没有堵塞。
b.en: NOT SURE YET. CHECK WHETHER THE MEASURING LINE IS BLOCKED.

text.zh: 按 Tab 查看管路，沿着 PT-02 连接的管道进行检查。
text.en: PRESS TAB TO VIEW THE PIPING AND FOLLOW THE PIPE CONNECTED TO PT-02.

text.zh: 切换到维护工具（4），打开 V-02 阀门。
text.en: SWITCH TO THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) AND OPEN VALVE V-02.

text.zh: 重新测量 PT-02，确认当前的压力读数。
text.en: MEASURE PT-02 AGAIN AND CONFIRM THE CURRENT PRESSURE READING.

text.zh: 切换到气液回收工具（5），把回收软管连接到 GAS-T1。
text.en: SWITCH TO GAS-LIQUID RECOVERY (5) AND CONNECT THE RECOVERY HOSE TO GAS-T1.

text.zh: 等待 TC-1 的压力降到 5 kPa 以下，按住 = 可以加快时间。
text.en: WAIT FOR THE PRESSURE AT TC-1 TO DROP BELOW 5 kPa. HOLD = TO SPEED UP TIME.

text.zh: 确认压力降下来以后，使用维护工具（4）拆除螺栓，再用抓钩（3）取下 P-002。
text.en: ONCE THE PRESSURE HAS DROPPED, USE THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) TO REMOVE THE BOLTS, THEN USE THE GRAPPLE (3) TO TAKE OFF P-002.

text.zh: 把拆下来的 P-002 送进金属熔炉，完成这次拆解练习。
text.en: DELIVER THE REMOVED P-002 INTO THE METAL FURNACE TO FINISH THIS DISMANTLING EXERCISE.

text.zh: 切换到测量工具（1），检查 E-T01 的电压读数。
text.en: SWITCH TO MEASURE (1) AND CHECK THE VOLTAGE READING AT E-T01.

text.zh: 使用维护工具（4），断开备用电池的 K-BT 开关。
text.en: USE THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) TO OPEN THE BACKUP BATTERY’S SWITCH K-BT.

text.zh: 再次测量 E-T01，检查断开备用电池以后还有没有电压。
text.en: MEASURE E-T01 AGAIN TO CHECK WHETHER ANY VOLTAGE REMAINS AFTER THE BACKUP BATTERY IS DISCONNECTED.

text.zh: 使用维护工具（4），连接 E-T02 放电接口，把设备里剩余的电量释放掉。
text.en: USE THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) TO CONNECT BLEED PORT E-T02 AND RELEASE THE CHARGE LEFT IN THE DEVICE.

text.zh: 重新测量 E-T01，确认电压已经降到 0 V。
text.en: MEASURE E-T01 AGAIN AND CONFIRM THE VOLTAGE HAS DROPPED TO 0 V.

text.zh: 确认没有残余电压以后，使用维护工具（4）拆除 G-T01 的固定螺栓和连接接头。
text.en: ONCE YOU HAVE CONFIRMED THERE IS NO RESIDUAL VOLTAGE, USE THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) TO REMOVE THE MOUNTING BOLTS AND CONNECTORS OF G-T01.

text.zh: 把拆下来的 G-T01 完整送到设备回收口，完成这次拆解练习。
text.en: DELIVER THE REMOVED G-T01 WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH TO FINISH THIS DISMANTLING EXERCISE.

text.zh: 使用激光切割工具（2），切断 LQ-1 管道，观察里面的液体会怎样流出来。
text.en: USE LASER (2) TO CUT PIPE LQ-1 AND WATCH HOW THE LIQUID INSIDE FLOWS OUT.

text.zh: 注意观察漂浮的液团。在失重环境下，液体不会向下掉落，如果接触到带电设备，还可能造成短路。
text.en: WATCH THE FLOATING BLOBS OF LIQUID. IN FREE FALL LIQUID DOESN’T FALL DOWN, AND IF IT TOUCHES LIVE EQUIPMENT IT CAN CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT.

text.zh: 切换到测量工具（1），检查小型储液罐 DR-L 排放口的读数。
text.en: SWITCH TO MEASURE (1) AND CHECK THE READING AT THE DRAIN PORT DR-L OF THE SMALL LIQUID TANK.

text.zh: 使用气液回收工具（5），把回收软管连接到 DR-L 排放口，将储液罐内的液体全部抽走。按住 = 可以加快时间。
text.en: USE GAS-LIQUID RECOVERY (5) TO CONNECT THE RECOVERY HOSE TO DRAIN PORT DR-L AND PUMP ALL THE LIQUID OUT OF THE TANK. HOLD = TO SPEED UP TIME.

text.zh: 确认储液罐已经排空以后，使用维护工具（4）拆下 LQ-T 储液罐。
text.en: ONCE YOU HAVE CONFIRMED THE TANK IS EMPTY, USE THE MAINTENANCE TOOL (4) TO REMOVE LIQUID TANK LQ-T.

text.zh: 把拆下来的 LQ-T 储液罐完整送到设备回收口，完成这次拆解练习。
text.en: DELIVER THE REMOVED LIQUID TANK LQ-T WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH TO FINISH THIS DISMANTLING EXERCISE.

text.zh: 检查冷却泵 CP-T 的所有连接管路，将冷却泵完整拆下来并送去回收。
text.en: CHECK ALL THE CONNECTING LINES OF COOLANT PUMP CP-T, THEN REMOVE THE PUMP WHOLE AND SEND IT OFF FOR RECOVERY.

text.zh: 把框架上的所有部件拆下来，清空整个框架。
text.en: REMOVE ALL THE COMPONENTS ON THE FRAME AND CLEAR THE WHOLE FRAME.
